content.subject: Proposed changes to the agreement
content.body:
I hope you’re well.

- The relevant clause reads "Client may terminate this Agreement at any time, without notice and without further payment." This could allow termination without notice and without compensation for work already performed. I suggest that either party may terminate for material breach upon fifteen (15) days written notice, and that the client shall pay for all services performed and expenses incurred up to the termination date.
- The relevant clause reads "All intellectual property rights in each Deliverable transfer to Client upon delivery." This would transfer ownership before payment is received. I propose that intellectual property rights in each Deliverable shall transfer to the client only upon full payment of the applicable invoice for that Deliverable.

Thank you for your consideration.
